name: mentoria-infra
description: Painel local para provisionar e gerenciar a infraestrutura AWS (EC2 + Docker) da plataforma Mentoria com Pulumi

scripts.dev: node scripts/doctor.mjs --warn && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev -w apps/api" "npm:dev -w apps/web"
scripts.start: node scripts/doctor.mjs --warn && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run start -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p pulumi && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
